policy: DSpec conservative routing policy. Capability tiers are project safety-routing classifications, not universal benchmark claims.

openai:gpt-5.6-sol.classification_basis: DSpec policy informed by provider positioning as the flagship model for complex reasoning/coding.
openai:gpt-5.6-sol.rationale: Frontier reasoning/coding tier in DSpec policy.

openai:gpt-5.6-terra.classification_basis: DSpec policy informed by provider positioning as the intelligence/cost balanced GPT-5.6 model.
openai:gpt-5.6-terra.rationale: Cost/capability balanced cloud tier in DSpec policy.

openai:gpt-5.6-luna.classification_basis: DSpec policy informed by provider positioning as the cost-sensitive GPT-5.6 model; never eligible for forced-advanced work.
openai:gpt-5.6-luna.rationale: Cost-sensitive cloud tier; not used for forced-advanced tasks.

anthropic:claude-sonnet-5.classification_basis: DSpec policy informed by Anthropic positioning Sonnet 5 as the current Sonnet model for developer/agent workloads.
anthropic:claude-sonnet-5.rationale: Strong current cloud reasoning/coding tier in DSpec policy.

anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6.classification_basis: DSpec policy informed by provider positioning for coding, agent planning, and knowledge work.
anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6.rationale: Strong cloud reasoning/coding tier in DSpec policy.

unknown_local_policy.note: Unrecognized local models may attempt only low-risk Easy work until their capability is established.

unknown_cloud_policy.note: Unrecognized cloud models are not automatically assigned work because DSpec lacks evidence for their safe capability tier.
